# A plain Go dependency nested inside the main module through a local
# replace is copied into the export, so its same-named user calls need
# the full rewrite check: eject must refuse the call as ambiguous
# instead of letting the spelling rewrite steal it.

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd kdmain
! logos eject -o out
stderr 'ambiguous EnableHTTP2ExtendedConnect'
! exists out
cd ..

-- kdmain/go.mod --
module example.com/h2kdcopy

go 1.27

require example.com/h2kddep v0.0.0

replace example.com/h2kddep => ./kddep

-- kdmain/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/h2kddep"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println("kdmain ready:", kddep.Serve())
}

-- kdmain/kddep/go.mod --
module example.com/h2kddep

go 1.27

-- kdmain/kddep/meter.go --
package kddep

// Meter is a user type with the same opt-in name as the fork-only
// (*net/http.Server) method. The export copies this nested dependency,
// so the rewrite would steal the call and the check must refuse it.
type Meter struct{ Hits int }

func (m *Meter) EnableHTTP2ExtendedConnect() { m.Hits++ }

-- kdmain/kddep/dep.go --
package kddep

import "net/http"

func Serve() int {
	m := &Meter{}
	m.EnableHTTP2ExtendedConnect()
	return len(http.MethodGet) + m.Hits
}
